title: Aerated Winey Korean Hazelnut Jjigae
description: A winey, aerated, satvik-friendly Korean dish featuring shelled hazelnuts, perfect for a date night, this jjigae is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Korean cuisine. It is baked to perfection and offers a rich and savory flavor profile.
instructions: Bake the hazelnuts in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 10 minutes, or until fragrant and lightly browned.
Grind the hazelnuts into a fine powder using a spice grinder or food processor.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add the chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soy sauce, wine, and hazelnut powder, and stir to combine.
Add the tofu and cook until lightly browned on all sides.
Add the green onions and sesame seeds, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
